messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-tail-latency p99 spike detected for /v1/stream endpoint. p95=820ms, p99=3.2s, SLO p99=1.0s. Error rate stable. Auto-escalation to #incidents and paging oncall.
alex (oncall): on it. paging history says we flipped a proxy change 20m ago? deploying to eu-proxy pool.
priya (sre): I see a correlated increase in connection resets from our edge proxies (nginx) starting ~22:05 UTC. Could be slow consumers + proxy buffer bloat.
tom (platform): rolling back the last deploy now — that was a config tweak to proxy_keepalive_timeout. rolling back to previous config.
deploy-bot: deploy rollback triggered by tom to service/proxy-config@release-2026-02-14, status: in_progress.
jen (support): Customer success flagged 3 customers seeing streaming stalls and aborted connections while using SSE. One is running long-lived streams with intermittent bursts.
alex (oncall): reproducing locally with stress script. Observed similar chunk delays when multiple concurrent slow clients are connected. suspect backpressure not propagated to upstream correctly.
marta (eng-runtime): can you paste the slow consumer pattern? we changed batching recently.
alex (oncall): here's the quick repro script we used: 
```bash
# simulate N clients that read slowly
for i in $(seq 1 50); do 
  curl -sS -N 'https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?token=test' | pv -qL 10 > /dev/null &
done
```
It shows head-of-line stalls after ~30 clients.
priya (sre): pulling proxy logs for that window. nginx error_log shows repeated "upstream prematurely closed connection" and "written body size exceeds buffer..." messages.
jen (support): customer note: they see payloads arriving in bursts every 10-30s instead of steady streaming. Some clients time out at 60s.
tom (platform): rollback completed, config reverted. Observability: tail latency dropped quickly in EU region but US still elevated. rolling restart of proxy-workers in us-west to flush connections.
alex (oncall): restarting proxy-workers now. also toggling keepalive_reuse off to force upstream connection churn as temporary mitigation.
priya (sre): enabled additional socket-level metrics and bumped proxy write timeout from 90s->120s to avoid premature disconnects for slow consumers. will monitor.
marta (eng-runtime): checking runtime KV cache and batching. No errors in tokenization, but we added new continuous-batching heuristic 2 days ago; could amplify tail. Dumping traces for streaming requests to see headroom.
alex (oncall): trace from sample request: 1) client connected -> proxy held chunk until buffer 16KB then flushed, 2) large flushes every ~12s. suggests proxy is buffering chunks instead of streaming them immediately.
jen (support): CS reached out to affected customer and confirmed they saw the same pattern across multiple regions. flagged as P2 impact (degraded real-time UX).
priya (sre): creating mitigation runbook entry: if streaming stalls detected: 1) check proxy error logs for "buffering" 2) restart proxy-workers 3) toggle keepalive_reuse 4) implement immediate backpressure metric alerts.
tom (platform): I've applied a transient proxy patch to disable response buffering on streaming routes (nginx: proxy_buffering off for /v1/stream). applying to canary then fleet.
deploy-bot: config update applied to service/proxy@canary-1, status: success.
alex (oncall): canary looks good — p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 520ms on canary nodes. pushing to fleet.
priya (sre): monitoring: p99 in us-west started trending down after restart + patch. still watching for regressions.
marta (eng-runtime): investigating whether the runtime's chunk coalescer is sending fragment sizes that trigger proxy buffering. adding instrumentation to log Content-Length and chunk timing.
jen (support): CS will notify customers that we're mitigating and ask for any client-side keepalive patterns.
alex (oncall): making handoff notes for next oncall: root cause likely interaction between proxy buffering and slow-consumer bursts; mitigations applied: rollback of earlier keepalive change, disable proxy_buffering on stream route, proxy-worker restarts.
priya (sre): logging this as incident-5100000000 in postmortem tracker. tagging teams: eng-runtime, platform, support. will collect timelines and metrics.
tom (platform): follow-ups: add canary gating for proxy config changes, add synthetic slow-consumer load tests against streaming endpoints, and create alert for upstream write-block time > 500ms.
marta (eng-runtime): follow-ups from runtime: emit chunk-timing histogram to telemetry, consider backpressure signal to runtime when proxy write stalls.
jen (support): Customer comms: initial incident update sent. will prepare follow-up once RCA established.
alex (oncall): ok handing off to priya for overnight watch. priya pls ack when you pick up.
priya (sre): acked. will monitor pages and escalate if p99 > 1s again. leaving details in #incidents log.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=P2, impacted_endpoints=["/v1/stream"], mitigations_applied=["rollback-proxy-keepalive","disable-proxy_buffering","restart-proxy-workers"]. paging closed. :white_check_mark:
